text:
deploy-bot: starting config-only rollout (r-98a4). Change-window 09:10-09:40 UTC. Canary: 3% for 12m. Changes: global_max_inflight: 200 -> 160, concurrent_per_worker: 8 -> 6, request_timeout_ms: 30000 -> 25000, batch_window_ms: 60 -> 45. No model changes.
clara: ack. which dashboards should we watch?
jon: p50/p95, error_rate_5xx, tails, and kvcache_miss. I'll monitor 09:12-09:30. :mag:
rachel: note from perf lab: reducing concurrent_per_worker sometimes raises p95 on heavy-tenants. Recommend tenant-pin playbook ready.
infra-oncall: pager set: 5xx > 0.4% sustained for 90s. DM to oncall if triggered. I'm on standby.
matt: added a quick rollback policy to rollout notes. auto-demote if p95 > 450ms for 90s OR error_rate > 0.5% for 60s. snippet below: 
```
{"rollback_conditions":[{"metric":"p95_latency_ms","threshold":450,"duration_s":90},{"metric":"error_rate_pct","threshold":0.5,"duration_s":60}]}
```
clara: can we add kvcache_miss rule? if miss_rate > 12% for 2m revert batch_window to 60ms.
jon: good call. add that. Also note: if a single tenant shows >200ms delta in p95, pin that tenant to old route instead of global rollback.
matt: pin command (ops run):
```
curl -XPOST "https://admin.internal/v1/tenants/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant_id":"T-77","route":"route-v1","duration":"30m"}'
```
rachel: I'll keep an eye on tenant T-77 and T-209, they historically spike.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic ramped to 3% at 1731012399. Current summary (09:16): p50=95ms, p95=230ms, error_rate=0.03%, kvcache_miss=5.5%. No alerts yet.
jon: saw a 1m spike to p95=480ms at 09:18 tied to tenant burst T-209. It's isolated but above threshold.
clara: ops - be ready to pin T-209 for 30m if it repeats.
infra-oncall: ready. pin executed via curl if you say go.
matt: recommendation: hold canary at 3% for remainder of window and do manual ramp to 20% for 10m if stable. If T-209 repeats, pin and then continue.
rachel: adding notes to release doc: exact param diffs, rollback JSON, pin playbook, change-window. :memo:
deploy-bot: Holding at 3% canary. 6m elapsed. Latest: p50=92ms, p95=240ms (was 480ms transient), error_rate=0.02%, kvcache_miss=6%. No auto-rollback triggered. Manual decision in 6m for ramp to 20%.
